contract: docs/PHASE_5.md: use the image as the reading surface, preserving the existing quiet green controls and warm neutral palette. Position selectable translations using the painted image and natural OCR boxes; expose original/copy/retry/details/contrast/dismiss with native keyboard controls. Hide unreliable geometry and show complete text with recovery guidance. Store only exact-origin exclusions and a contrast boolean. Target 375x812, 768x900 and 1440x900, with a compact 330px popup. Local references are Phase 4 captures and existing popup styling.

accessibility.evidence: The final browser run has zero axe violations on all three result viewports and the popup. Trusted keyboard activation, original/translation toggle, details, known-text copy, high contrast and Dismiss/focus restoration pass. Rendered captures show visible focus and readable labels. Region language, connected field labels and expanded/pressed states are implemented. Screen reader and native Chrome popup/dialog behavior remain explicitly manual. This is scoped evidence, not a full WCAG claim.

responsive.evidence: Final 375x812, 768x900 and 1440x900 captures were inspected: translated boxes align, text and controls fit and there is no horizontal page overflow. Numeric browser assertions cover fit/crop/position/scale/scroll/resize and clipping, plus 150% visual-viewport zoom with bounded controls. Unsupported layouts open text details rather than guessing.

loading.evidence: overlay-loading.png shows a real pending OCR/model/translation request with stage feedback and Cancel. The suite separately disables a site during actual local work and verifies the worker host closes.

empty.evidence: The final image regression's ocr-empty.png shows actual NO_TEXT_FOUND guidance with Retry and Dismiss. First-use checks also preserve OCR and Setup guidance without a downloaded model.

error.evidence: overlay-unsupported.png shows actual rotated-layout rejection, automatically opened selectable text and a reason. The final suite verifies restoring a supported layout restores the overlay. Prior failed automatic opening was repaired and the complete run passes.

partial.evidence: Actual crop/ancestor-clipping cases keep the original geometry and mark unavailable regions. The explicitly synthetic long-text fixture in overlay-literal-long-text.png triggers overflow guidance while Text details retains the complete string; it is not claimed as model inference.

success.evidence: Actual cached Tesseract/NLLB produces Buka pintunya. and Selamat pagi. at matching OCR line positions. Original comparison, Copy, Retry and independent controls pass. The warm-neutral backing covers the source text while preserving the image.

permission.evidence: The popup site preference is tested through actual checkbox interactions, persistence, disabled activation and manual re-enabling. Image regression also shows named-host guidance in images-permission.png without fetching the ungranted host. Native grant/deny dialogs remain manual; no new permission is requested.

renderedEvidence.observation: Narrow image translations remain aligned and readable, with a bounded compact panel and wrapped native actions. The opaque backing prevents source text bleed-through.
Tablet layout scales translated regions with the image; original/copy/retry/contrast/details/dismiss remain reachable without horizontal overflow.
Desktop image carries two mapped text regions and the control panel uses space below it. Clear status and focus remain visible.
The compact popup preserves language fields, exact-origin preference, explicit activation, local model readiness and Setup within the content column.
At 150% visual-viewport zoom the mapped text remains aligned and controls stay within the visible viewport; limited space can put the panel over image content.
Rotated source pixels retain no guessed overlay; the expanded labeled fields show complete translated/original text and explain the mapping limitation.
HTML-like fixture strings are literal text, long regions stay bounded and overflow guidance leads to the complete details field.
The unchecked site preference disables activation and its origin scope stays visible. Re-enabling remains a manual page action.
Actual local processing shows a named stage and Cancel; no remote assets are downloaded by this journey.
